deck.name: Flutter widgets
deck.description: The building blocks you reach for every day.

cards.back: Its configuration is **immutable**. It only changes when the parent rebuilds it with new arguments.
When the widget owns **mutable state** that changes over its lifetime, such as an animation controller or a text field.
A handle to a widget's location in the *element tree*. Used to look up ancestors like `Theme.of(context)`.
`Expanded` forces the child to fill the free space. `Flexible` lets it be *up to* that size (`fit: FlexFit.loose`).
Identical const widgets are **canonicalized**, so Flutter can skip rebuilding that subtree.
It builds children **lazily**, only those near the viewport. Use it for long or unbounded lists.
Preserves the identity of an element when widgets move within the same parent. Needed for reorderable lists.
The parent's **constraints**, so you can choose a layout based on available space instead of screen size.

cards.front: How do you stop work in `dispose()`?
cards.back: Cancel timers and subscriptions, and call `dispose()` on controllers such as `AnimationController`.
It gives a subtree its own **layer**, so a frequently repainting child doesn't force its siblings to repaint.
`Stack` layers children. `Positioned` pins a child to edges of the stack using `top`, `left`, `right`, `bottom`.
Whether the canvas must be redrawn when the painter is replaced. Compare the **data**, not identity, to avoid needless paints.
